verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for a payroll/HR platform, but the evidence never shows Gusto offering a versioned automation or workflow object with review history or rollback. What it does show is adjacent: an optimistic-concurrency `version` field on records, API version headers, pinnable CLI releases, and a `--dry-run`/`--confirm` gate that previews single writes. A dry-run preview of one write is not versioning or rollback of a recurring automation, so none of this earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
